item.description:
NoManos 2.6.6
- Voice echo prevention: detect when the microphone picks up NoManos's own speech mid-utterance so it no longer responds to itself. - Progress watchdog: back off repeated "still working" notices exponentially instead of announcing them at a fixed interval.

NoManos 2.6.5
- Voice routing & relevance: preserve requests alongside listening and detail commands, and incorporate recent conversation context in relevance decisions. - Task tracking: retain useful task titles through retries and maintain task prompt lineage. - Usage recovery & progress: use the active harness for recovery and monitor background progress with silence watchdog warnings. - Model discovery: cached model discovery, updated quota mappings, and expanded model limit pool. - Relaunch workflow: verified relaunch script and workflow.

NoManos 2.6.4
- Task title formatting: combined topic and request details with semibold styling in task lists. - Task diff view: inspect file diffs across tasks with prompt lineage and request links. - Usage-limit recovery: automatic recovery and resumption for tasks stopped by usage limits. - Speech recognition recovery: deadline monitoring and reliable recovery after recognition stalls. - Stop button isolation: stopping a transcript prompt or thinking generation no longer cancels running background tasks. - Device volume policy: coordinated volume handling and improved voice processing demand control.
